info.title: DCAT Register
info.description: DCAT-AP-NL open-data register for OpenRegister. Holds a single Dataset schema aligned to the DCAT-AP-NL standard (https://data.overheid.nl/dcat-ap-nl). A dataset's files become its distributions.

dcat.title: DCAT
dcat.description: Open-data register. Datasets are published as DCAT-AP-NL and can be harvested by OpenCatalogi.

dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.description: A DCAT-AP-NL dataset: a published, findable collection of open data. Files attached to the object become its distributions.

category.description: Theme/category of the dataset (dcat:theme), e.g. a value from the EU data theme vocabulary.

license.description: License under which the dataset is published (dct:license), e.g. CC0-1.0.

publicatiedatum.description: Publication date (dct:issued). Datasets with a publicatiedatum at or before now are publicly visible.

landingPage.description: URL of a human-readable landing page for the dataset (dcat:landingPage).

publisher.description: Name of the organisation publishing the dataset (dct:publisher).
